text: Cyrus the Great founded the Achaemenid Persian Empire after conquering the Median Empire
Cyrus the Great conquered Babylon and freed the Jewish exiles
Cambyses II conquered Egypt, adding it to the Persian Empire
Persian forces were defeated by the Greeks at the Battle of Marathon
Xerxes I invaded Greece and won the Battle of Thermopylae
Alexander the Great began his conquest of the Persian Empire at the Battle of Granicus
The Parthian Empire was founded by Arsaces I
Ardashir I overthrew the Parthians and founded the Sassanid Empire
Sassanid King Shapur I captured Roman Emperor Valerian at Edessa
The Sassanid Empire fell to the Arab conquests, ending ancient Persian rule
